projects.title: Desk cable dock
projects.description: Give charging cables a home within easy reach. Start by measuring the cables you use most.
projects.notes: Measure cable diameters and desk space. Reference model is inspiration; check its fit, license, and printer profile.

projects.title: Adapter sorting tray
projects.description: A small tray for USB adapters, memory cards, and the little things that disappear.
projects.notes: Measure the largest adapter and the available drawer space.

projects.title: Home-lab cable labels
projects.description: Readable labels for both ends of your network and power cables.
projects.notes: List labels and measure cable diameters before choosing a design.

projects.title: Desk pen station
projects.description: One spot for pens, a stylus, and everyday desk tools.
projects.notes: A reference design to consider; confirm dimensions and license before printing.

projects.title: Personalized phone stand
projects.description: A phone stand in a chosen color, with room for the charging cable.
projects.notes: Measure the phone with its case, charging connector, and preferred viewing angle.

projects.title: Entryway catchall
projects.description: A dedicated place for keys and everyday pocket items, sized for your entryway.
projects.notes: Choose the footprint together and measure the shelf.

projects.title: Favorite-book bookmark
projects.description: A flat bookmark with an initial, a simple pattern, or a favorite motif.
projects.notes: Choose a motif and smooth the edges after printing.

projects.title: Custom drawer dividers
projects.description: A made-to-fit organizer for whichever drawer needs a little order.
projects.notes: Measure internal drawer width, depth, and height; leave fit clearance.

projects.title: Mission control pencil cup
projects.description: A space-themed pencil holder for drawing, homework, and big plans.
projects.notes: Let him choose the theme and color. Prefer a stable, one-piece design; check edges.

projects.title: Personalized room sign
projects.description: His name or a made-up clubhouse name, in colors he chooses.
projects.notes: Choose lettering together. An adult handles mounting; keep it away from the bed.

projects.title: Toy-car display stand
projects.description: A small display for his favorite cars or other small collectibles.
projects.notes: Measure the toys first. Choose a stable design and check fit with one test print.

projects.title: Drawing stencil set
projects.description: Reusable stencils for rockets, animals, or geometric patterns.
projects.notes: Choose large, one-piece stencils, smooth edges, and adult-supervised use.

projects.title: My-color crayon caddy
projects.description: A sturdy home for chunky crayons, in her favorite color.
projects.notes: Measure crayons, use a stable one-piece design, and inspect for sharp edges or cracks. Adult-supervised use.

projects.title: Personalized bedroom sign
projects.description: A cheerful name sign with a favorite shape or color she chooses.
projects.notes: Decorative item mounted by an adult out of reach; avoid detachable small decorations.

projects.title: Big-shape drawing stencils
projects.description: Large circles, stars, or animal outlines for drawing together.
projects.notes: Choose large one-piece designs without detachable parts. Smooth edges and supervise use; not for mouthing.

projects.title: Picture-book display stand
projects.description: A sturdy little stand to show off this week’s favorite picture book.
projects.notes: Measure the book and choose a wide stable base. Adult places and checks the stand.
